reference_sql:
SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.ship_to_country = 'BE'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.parent_category
alternatives: SELECT s.parent_category, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND s.order_month = DATE '2025-03-01' GROUP BY s.parent_category
